content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIHPH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIHPH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Hygiene and Public Health (AIIHPH) for project-based research positions under an ICMR-funded project based in Kolkata, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under AIIHPH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced across different posts including Project Research Scientist - III (Medical) and Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical) positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIHPH Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications is 30th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist - III (Medical)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Research Scientist - III (Medical) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 93,000/- plus admissible HRA as per project norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Research Scientist - III (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess MBBS / BVSc / BDS along with a Post Graduate Degree or MPH/PhD, supplemented by three years of post-qualification professional experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical) position is set at 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIHPH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online Google Form provided by the institute before the deadline of 30th October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for these posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by the All India Institute of Hygiene and Public Health for these positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these research posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises the shortlisting of eligible candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details, notification PDF link, and the online application link directly within the Important Links section of this article.
